CPU/GPU sensor library: LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6 (MPL-2.0).
Unmodified library binaries and .NET dependencies from the official release:
https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/releases/tag/v0.9.6
Library source: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/tree/v0.9.6
Read-only CPU/GPU bridge source is included in app.asar: qingchang/hardware-sensor.cs.
Rebuild with scripts/build-qingchang-sensors.ps1 in the project source.
The bridge opens CPU/GPU sensors only. It does not write fan controls or clocks.
PawnIO official unmodified installer 2.2.0, signed by namazso.eu:
https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/tag/2.2.0
The installer is launched only when the user clicks Install CPU sensor driver.
The application does not silently install drivers or disable Windows security settings.
